uiCopy.privacyBody: The browser creates the draw locally; the result URL stores cards, not personal text.
uiCopy.nextActionBody: List one observation that would support this interpretation and one that would contradict it.

disclaimer: For entertainment and self-reflection only. Tarot is symbolic guidance, not professional, medical, legal, or financial advice.

pages.title: A transparent three-card tarot sampler
pages.intro: Each position is named before you draw, so you can judge whether the reflection fits your question.
pages.questionLabel: What would you like this spread to help you review?
pages.questionPlaceholder: Example: What should I check before making this plan?
pages.journalPrompt: Mark the sentence that feels testable, then write what evidence you will look for.
pages.resultCopy: A trustworthy reflection makes its limits visible and leaves room for your own evidence.
pages.metaDescription: Try a transparent free three-card tarot sampler with named positions and a verification prompt.

pages.title: A careful love tarot sampler
pages.intro: Reflect on your need, the connection, and the conversation that deserves honest attention.
pages.questionLabel: Which relationship question would you like to examine?
pages.questionPlaceholder: Example: What should I clarify before assuming how they feel?
pages.journalPrompt: Separate what you know from what you are guessing about the other person.
pages.resultCopy: Good relationship insight respects uncertainty, privacy, and the other person’s right to answer for themselves.
pages.metaDescription: Try a careful free love tarot sampler focused on needs, connection, and clear communication.

pages.title: Yes or no tarot, with the missing context
pages.intro: A one-card lean is only a starting point. Add facts, constraints, and your own decision rule.
pages.questionLabel: What choice would benefit from a second look?
pages.questionPlaceholder: Example: Is waiting one more week the wiser option?
pages.journalPrompt: Write the condition that would make you change your mind.
pages.resultCopy: The responsible answer is often conditional. Let the card open the review instead of closing it.
pages.seoTitle: Yes or No Tarot Reading Sampler
pages.metaDescription: Sample a free yes-or-no tarot reflection with an explicit context and decision check.

pages.title: A daily card you can review later
pages.intro: Draw one symbolic theme and note what actually happens, without turning the card into a promise.
pages.questionLabel: What would you like to observe today?
pages.journalPrompt: At day’s end, note one moment that matched and one that did not.
pages.resultCopy: Reflection gets stronger when you compare the symbol with lived experience honestly.
pages.metaDescription: Draw a free daily tarot sampler card and compare its theme with your lived experience.
